training.dtype: Use the original checkpoint arrays and NumPy float64 scoring; do not quantize/cast weights. Paper's 2248-byte float32 storage accounting is not the saved software arithmetic.

features.scale: max(1.4826*MAD, population std); if <=1e-8 replace with 1; median center; abs(asinh((v-center)/scale))
features.channels: one axial vibration channel, mean and signed-extreme summaries coincide; tach/speed unused
features.segment: one full source record is one acquisition; no window subdivision or extra averaging
features.long_record_spectrum: native V12 x[::ceil(n/16384)][:16384], then center, Hann, rFFT, omit DC; normalized bins. Full record for time features. No extra filters/resampling.

alarm.reference: max finite 13th-largest score in full 21-score windows of concatenated training+calibration history
alarm.fallback_rows: calibration only, linear NumPy quantile interpolation
alarm.state: trailing full 21 scores; continuous through commissioning, healthy/fault boundary and calendar gaps; no reset or latch; no alarm until full window

snd.mapping: ASSUMED DATASET02..07 = Turbine1..6; Turbine5 = DATASET06; time-only check cannot positively verify identity
snd.replacement_rule: Turbine5 retain time <1.2 years; exclude time >=1.2 before vibration parsing; never infer a new cutoff from gaps
snd.rms_definition: uncentered sqrt(mean(raw_float64_vibration**2)) over all 16384 samples, strict >0.5g, before float32 V12 cast
snd.sensitivity: Rerun identical fixed pipeline on all eligible records; independently re-estimate own onset, chronological partitions, scaling and threshold on that arm. No common t* selected by outcome.
snd.turbine2_sensor_issue: Retain early documented electrical sensor issue; no censoring or repair; report explicitly.

identity_gate.stop: invalid/nonfinite/duplicate/reversed time, fewer than 2 rows, failure to bracket both events, or event gaps near both events only in alternative turbine(s) and none in assumed Turbine5; no remapping
identity_gate.gap_interpretation: A gap is strictly greater than max(7/365.25 years,10*median positive time step); event match if gap interval intersects event +/-0.1 years. Thresholds are blind safeguards, not publisher facts or identity proof. No gaps or ambiguous common gaps retain mapping as an unverified assumption.

onset.unit: Turbine5 only, its arm-specific included record before 1.2 years, never other turbines or HSS
onset.departure: root mean square of five standardized descriptors
onset.confirmation: first 3-of-5 exceedance with window end index >=100; backdate to first exceedance in that five-record window (zero-based indices)
onset.no_onset: STOP and report not evaluable; no documented onset-substitution fallback found. Strongest-change diagnostic is not a substitute. No 50%, 1-year, or best-alarm boundary.
onset.limitations: retrospective feature-departure proxy, shared descriptor families with detector, unknown physical damage onset; no claim of prospective onset estimation

partitions.rule: healthy sequence length h>=15; train_end=max(5,floor(.60*h)); cal_end=min(max(train_end+5,floor(.80*h)),h-5); remainder healthy test
partitions.fault: Turbine5 rows [0,t*) assumed healthy; [t*,replacement) fault test
partitions.controls: full record after arm inclusion split 60/20/20; last20% healthy test only; commissioning is train+cal, not scored test

hss.ordering: lexical timestamp filename, all 50 records, including both March17 records; record-day not literal unique calendar date
hss.commissioning: fixed 30% training + next10% calibration, assumed healthy; no onset estimation or RMS operating filter
hss.precedes_failure: first alarm record-day <50; day50 alone is not advance warning; failure by last record is not exact failure timestamp
hss.threshold: 20-history scores <21 => twice q0.995 of calibration days16..20 only; keep causal 13/21 rule

outcomes.hypothesis: Frozen cohort-trained global H12 with local commissioning transfers to unseen turbines: Turbine5 has no healthy-test alarm and at least one fault-test alarm, and all five controls remain silent in their held-out tests.
outcomes.primary: SND per seed strict successes /6, per-unit healthy_alarm/fault_detected/strict_success, and total /18 unit-seed evaluations; all 6 machines shown
outcomes.timing: Turbine5 first post-commissioning alarm in years; alarm time minus1.2 years (negative=before replacement) and 1.2-alarm time; include premature alarms
outcomes.secondary: HSS first alarm day and whether day<50, per seed; no strict score, do not pool with SND
outcomes.no_alarm: null timing, false detection; never impute last record as alarm
outcomes.dependence: 6 machines from 1 farm; three seeds are repeated evaluations, not 18 independent machines

prohibited: unseen units in FL or weight adaptation
post-result changes to k,m,alpha,features,preprocessing,model,rounds,inclusion,cutoff,partitions or onset rule
